notes: The public VDP explicitly places GPU memory-isolation and tenant-breakout flaws in scope, treats compliant research as authorized activity, requires use of the researcher's own resources, and requires immediate stop/report on encountering user data. The safe harbor does not extend to third-party upstream infrastructure, so testing is limited to resources and reference images within the marketplace's own scope; no host or data-center testing directly. Classified full-probe-ok for the bounded GPU-SEAL battery within those limits. Real provider identity and source URLs are kept in the untracked private review record (CHARTER.md §7.6).
